A_procurement_gate_taxonomy.description: Taxonomy of 20 procurement gates Rig Relay must satisfy for enterprise readiness.

gates.current_evidence: Threat model v0 exists (17 threats, 6 mitigations, 5 release gates). Security policy v0 exists. WebSocket hardening implemented. Environment scrubbing, bash pattern detection, dirty-file preservation in place.
gates.missing_evidence: No formal security architecture document. No data flow diagrams. No trust boundary documentation beyond threat model. No penetration test reports. No security review signoff.
gates.implementation_gaps: Prompt injection defenses partial. No automated secret scanning on trace writes. CSP headers missing from generated docs. No network egress controls for agents.
gates.documentation_gaps: No security whitepaper. No security architecture summary for procurement. No encryption-at-rest documentation.
gates.test_gaps: No adversarial prompt injection tests. No fuzzing tests. No penetration test suite.
gates.recommended_next_slice: Produce security architecture summary artifact; add automated secret scanning to trace writes; add CSP headers to static site.

gates.current_evidence: Usage data doctrine comprehensive (3-tier retention, content-light guarantees, redaction before export). Privacy notice alpha exists. Telemetry contribution policy established. Frontend rendering safety doctrine.
gates.missing_evidence: No formal Data Protection Impact Assessment (DPIA). No data retention schedule by data class. No data deletion verification procedure. No privacy-by-design documentation.
gates.implementation_gaps: Content-light guarantees verified via redaction validator but scope limited to export paths. No automated continuous privacy scanning.
gates.documentation_gaps: No privacy whitepaper for procurement. No GDPR/CCPA readiness statement.
gates.test_gaps: No automated privacy boundary tests across all emission surfaces.
gates.recommended_next_slice: Produce data inventory artifact with retention schedule; add privacy boundary CI tests.

gates.current_evidence: Product telemetry is first-party, enabled by default, and opt-out. Remote telemetry contribution is separately gated by consent scopes. Telemetry budget enforced. Content-light guarantee on all emission paths. Local operational observability and enterprise audit/evidence are separate from product telemetry and remain mandatory for governed operation.
gates.missing_evidence: No plain-language telemetry disclosure for enterprise procurement. No cockpit telemetry state indicator. No explicit degraded-behavior matrix distinguishing product-telemetry degradation from governance/audit/evidence continuity. No procurement-facing disclosure that product telemetry, remote contribution, local operational observability, and enterprise audit/evidence are distinct policy surfaces.
gates.implementation_gaps: Product-telemetry-disabled degradation described in doctrine but exact degraded behaviors (adaptive recommendations, UX optimization, agent-tool optimization, Ralph refinement, orchestrator/subagent behavior) not exhaustively enumerated. Evidence continuity guarantee not independently verifiable — product telemetry opt-out must not disable governance, receipts, release gates, audit trails, local operational observability, or enterprise evidence records.
gates.documentation_gaps: No plain-language telemetry disclosure doc for enterprise procurement. No degraded-behavior matrix. No evidence continuity guarantee document.
gates.test_gaps: No automated tests verifying product-telemetry-disabled mode degrades adaptive/product-learning behavior but preserves governance, receipts, release-gate records, mutation receipts, schema validation records, export manifests, and enterprise audit events.
gates.recommended_next_slice: Produce telemetry disclosure document separating product telemetry (default-on, opt-out), remote telemetry contribution (settings-controlled), local operational observability (mandatory), and enterprise audit/evidence (mandatory). Produce degraded-behavior matrix. Produce evidence continuity guarantee. Add cockpit telemetry/evidence state indicators. Add automated tests proving product-telemetry-disabled does not disable governance/audit/evidence records.

gates.current_evidence: Identity package with GitHub and Google OAuth providers. Token store, consent store. WebSocket auth token required. Step-up authorization for high-authority actions. Local-only default.
gates.missing_evidence: No RBAC model. No SCIM provisioning plan. No SSO/SAML support. No multi-user access control (single-local-user only). No audit log of authentication events.
gates.implementation_gaps: Single-user local model only. No separation of operator vs administrator roles. No tenant/org boundaries implemented in code (schemas exist).
gates.documentation_gaps: No access control policy document. No identity federation roadmap.
gates.test_gaps: No RBAC enforcement tests. No multi-tenant isolation tests.
gates.recommended_next_slice: Design and document RBAC model; implement audit logging of auth events; plan SSO/SCIM roadmap.

gates.current_evidence: Observability event stream (JSONL). Receipt store with Merkle links. Tamper-evidence design exists (3-layer: hash chain, checkpoints, external anchoring) but not implemented. Audit trail store exists.
gates.missing_evidence: No immutable audit log. Tamper-evidence not implemented. No audit log export for SIEM integration. No audit retention policy beyond storage retention policy.
gates.implementation_gaps: AuditTrailStore exists but tamper-evidence layers not implemented. No audit event schema for admin/security events. No audit log query interface.
gates.documentation_gaps: No audit logging policy document. No audit event catalog.
gates.test_gaps: No tamper-evidence verification tests. No audit log integrity tests.
gates.recommended_next_slice: Implement event hash chain (Layer 1 of tamper-evidence design); produce audit event catalog.

gates.current_evidence: Storage retention policy defines three tiers (hot/warm/cold). Budget schema with days/mb caps. GC scripts with dry-run defaults. Protected classes defined. Usage data doctrine defines export rules.
gates.missing_evidence: No verified data deletion procedure. No data export format documentation. No right-to-deletion workflow (GDPR Article 17). No retention schedule by data class.
gates.implementation_gaps: GC scripts exist but full deletion verification not automated. Export is manual script-based. No self-service data export for users.
gates.documentation_gaps: No data retention schedule document. No data export guide for enterprise admins.
gates.test_gaps: No deletion verification tests. No export format validation tests.
gates.recommended_next_slice: Produce data retention schedule; implement deletion verification; document export procedures.

gates.current_evidence: Multiple install channels documented (uv tool, pipx, pip, homebrew, npm, source, Nix). Update policy with state machine. Release packaging for macOS/Windows/Linux via PyInstaller. CI/CD in GitHub Actions.
gates.missing_evidence: No admin deployment guide. No system requirements document. No operational runbook. No health check/monitoring endpoints. No configuration management documentation for enterprise deployment.
gates.implementation_gaps: No health check API. No admin CLI for operations. No configuration validation command. No backup/restore procedures.
gates.documentation_gaps: No admin operations guide. No deployment architecture document. No scaling guidance.
gates.test_gaps: No deployment smoke tests beyond binary smoke tests. No config validation tests.
gates.recommended_next_slice: Produce admin deployment guide; add health check endpoint; create config validation command.

gates.current_evidence: uv lock file pins all dependencies. CI uses pinned action SHAs. Dependency policy defines 3-bucket model. No automatic dependency updates.
gates.missing_evidence: No SBOM generation. No dependency vulnerability scanning (pip-audit/safety). No provenance attestations for builds. No SLSA compliance. No dependency review in CI. No signed commits requirement.
gates.implementation_gaps: No SBOM pipeline. No vulnerability scanning in CI. Build artifacts not signed. No SLSA provenance generation.
gates.documentation_gaps: No SBOM policy. No vulnerability disclosure policy. No supply-chain security document.
gates.test_gaps: No SBOM validation tests. No dependency license compatibility tests.
gates.recommended_next_slice: Add pip-audit to CI; generate SBOM (SPDX/CycloneDX); implement build provenance attestation.

gates.current_evidence: CodeQL scanning in CI (Python + JavaScript). SECURITY.md with reporting process. GitHub Security Advisories enabled.
gates.missing_evidence: No vulnerability disclosure policy (VDP). No CVE assignment process. No patching SLA. No vulnerability scanning on dependencies. No security bulletin process.
gates.implementation_gaps: CodeQL runs but dependency scanning missing. No automated vulnerability alerting.
gates.documentation_gaps: No vulnerability management policy. No security advisory template.
gates.test_gaps: No regression tests for known vulnerabilities.
gates.recommended_next_slice: Draft vulnerability disclosure policy; add dependency vulnerability scanning; define patching SLA.

gates.current_evidence: AGPL-3.0-or-later license. UPSTREAM.md documents fork lineage. ATTRIBUTION.md exists. THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md exists. Dependency policy with 3-bucket model.
gates.missing_evidence: No automated license compatibility check. No full dependency license inventory. No license change detection. No policy for copyleft vs permissive dependencies.
gates.implementation_gaps: No license scanning in CI. No SBOM with license metadata.
gates.documentation_gaps: No license compatibility matrix. No third-party dependency inventory with license details.
gates.test_gaps: No license compatibility tests.
gates.recommended_next_slice: Add license scanning to CI; produce third-party license inventory; document license compatibility policy.

gates.current_evidence: PyInstaller builds for 5 platforms. Manifest generation in CI. GitHub Actions as canonical release mint. Nix builds.
gates.missing_evidence: No SLSA provenance. No build attestation signing. No reproducible build verification. No checksum publication for releases. No SBOM attached to releases.
gates.implementation_gaps: Build artifacts produced but not attested. Release manifest exists but not cryptographically signed.
gates.documentation_gaps: No build provenance documentation for procurement.
gates.test_gaps: No reproducible build tests. No provenance verification tests.
gates.recommended_next_slice: Generate SLSA provenance; sign release artifacts; publish checksums with releases.

gates.current_evidence: Security reporting via GitHub Advisories. SECURITY.md documents supported version line.
gates.missing_evidence: No incident response plan. No incident classification taxonomy. No communication plan. No post-incident review process. No security contact list.
gates.implementation_gaps: No automated incident detection. No alerting pipeline.
gates.documentation_gaps: No incident response plan document. No runbook. No escalation procedures.
gates.test_gaps: No incident response tabletop exercise results.
gates.recommended_next_slice: Draft incident response plan; define incident classification; establish security contact process.

gates.current_evidence: Structured logging with configurable levels. Observability event stream. DuckDB read-side analytics. Debug bundle scripts (chatgpt_dev, telemetry). Dataset inspector marimo notebook.
gates.missing_evidence: No support model definition. No SLA commitment. No support ticket workflow. No health dashboard. No Prometheus metrics endpoint.
gates.implementation_gaps: Rich observability for development but no production-grade monitoring. No alerting. No structured support diagnostics.
gates.documentation_gaps: No support policy. No troubleshooting guide for enterprise admins. No known-issues register.
gates.test_gaps: No support diagnostic validation tests.
gates.recommended_next_slice: Define support model; add health check endpoint; create troubleshooting guide.

gates.current_evidence: Layered config system (project .rig/relay/config.toml, user ~/.rig/relay/config.toml). Environment variable overrides. Config patch primitives. Telemetry budget and storage budget schemas.
gates.missing_evidence: No enterprise deployment config (org-wide policy, provider allowlists, tool restrictions). No configuration validation command. No configuration drift detection.

gates.test_gaps: No config validation boundary tests. No config integrity tests.
gates.recommended_next_slice: Design enterprise config layer (org policies, provider allowlists); add config validation command.

K_telemetry_operational_evidence_boundar.description: Explicit doctrinal boundary between product telemetry, remote telemetry contribution, local operational observability, and enterprise audit/evidence substrate. This section is normative for all procurement artifacts.

product_telemetry.definition: First-party, enabled by default, opt-out. Used for product improvement, adaptive behavior, UX optimization, agent-tool optimization, Ralph/orchestrator/subagent refinement, derived/aggregate intelligence, benchmarks, and reports.
product_telemetry.opt_out_behavior: Opt-out visibly degrades adaptive/product-learning behavior: adaptive recommendations, UX optimization feedback, agent-tool optimization, Ralph refinement, orchestrator behavior, and subagent behavior. Must not disable governance, auditability, receipt persistence, release-gate evidence, mutation receipts, schema validation records, export manifests, enterprise audit logs, local operational observability, or incident investigation records.
product_telemetry.commercialization_boundary: Aggregated, de-identified, or derived product intelligence may be commercialized. Raw user content, prompts, credentials, secrets, private files, and private repository contents must never be commercialized.

remote_telemetry_contribution.definition: Any upload or remote sharing of telemetry outside the local machine. A policy layer above the evidence substrate, not the substrate itself.
remote_telemetry_contribution.control_surface: Explicitly disclosed and controlled by settings/policy. Enterprise policy may disable it. Content-light, de-identified/aggregated where applicable.
remote_telemetry_contribution.opt_out_behavior: Disabling remote contribution does not disable local governance, audit, receipts, release gates, or enterprise evidence. Only blocks remote upload of product-telemetry or contribution bundles.
remote_telemetry_contribution.commercialization_boundary: Remote contribution bundles must never contain raw user content. Contribution consent scopes define what may be shared.

local_operational_observability.definition: Local content-light events, receipts, traces, release-gate records, schema validation records, projection invalidation, local diagnostics, and cockpit operational health. Required for governed operation and user trust.
local_operational_observability.opt_out_behavior: Not subject to product-telemetry opt-out. May degrade in depth only if a separate local diagnostics setting is disabled. Must remain inspectable, content-light, schema-governed, and auditable.
local_operational_observability.evidence_continuity: Must continue functioning when product telemetry is disabled. Must not silently stop refreshing because remote telemetry contribution is disabled.

enterprise_audit_evidence_substrate.definition: Enterprise audit events, mutation receipts, release-gate decisions, receipt envelopes, export manifests, schema registry, artifact registry, provider permission evidence, and procurement evidence packs.
enterprise_audit_evidence_substrate.opt_out_behavior: Must continue functioning when product telemetry is disabled. Must not be gated on telemetry consent or remote contribution settings. Must support incident investigation, compliance review, export/replay, and governance gates.
enterprise_audit_evidence_substrate.evidence_continuity: Mandatory. Must never silently stop refreshing because telemetry is disabled. Product telemetry opt-out must not disable Postgres audit/evidence continuity in enterprise mode.

must_disclose_separately: Product telemetry: default-on, opt-out, what degrades when disabled
Local operational observability: mandatory for governed operation
Enterprise audit/evidence: mandatory in enterprise mode
must_not_imply: That product-telemetry opt-out disables governance or audit
That remote contribution consent gates local evidence records
That enterprise audit trails are optional tracking

blocker_gates: G17: Hosted and Team Deployment Readiness
summary.overall_verdict: Not enterprise procurement ready. 7 blocker gates must be resolved before any credible enterprise procurement review. An additional 9 high-risk gates represent significant gaps. Rig Relay is architecturally sound for local-first usage but lacks the organizational, legal, and operational infrastructure required for enterprise procurement.
